decks.notes: This mono green aggro deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost creatures and using cards like Ba Sing Se and Earthbender Ascension to quickly build up board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Escape Tunnel and Fabled Passage to thin the deck and ensure consistency in drawing key cards. The inclusion of cards like Demolition Field and Surrak, Elusive Hunter provide additional reach and removal options to secure victory. Overall, this deck aims to establish dominance early and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells and counterspells while also drawing cards and generating value. It aims to outlast the opponent and win through card advantage and powerful late-game threats. Key cards include Firebending Lesson, Jeskai Revelation, and Gran-Gran for card draw and value generation, as well as Combustion Technique and Splatter Technique for removal. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Thor, God of Thunder and Iroh's Demonstration to close out the game once the opponent is exhausted. It utilizes a mix of spells and creatures to maintain control and dictate the pace of the game.

The main idea is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage, while playing aggressive creatures like Badgermole Cub and Mossborn Hydra to deal damage early on. Ba Sing Se and Earthbender Ascension provide additional control and power, while cards like Escape Tunnel and Demolition Field disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, powerful creatures and mana advantage to win the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to use a combination of cards to quickly bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard (reanimation) and create a powerful board presence that overwhelms the opponent. The deck also includes various control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own creatures. The cards included in the deck are carefully selected to work together in a combo to achieve this goal efficiently and effectively. The strategy revolves around efficiently reanimating creatures and using their abilities to gain an advantage over the opponent.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to use efficient spells and creatures to quickly apply pressure on the opponent, aiming to deal damage as fast as possible. By utilizing low-cost spells like Opt, Burst Lightning, and Sleight of Hand, combined with creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Slickshot Show-Off, the deck can overwhelm the opponent early on. The inclusion of bounce spells like Boomerang Basics and Prismari Charm adds versatility, allowing the deck to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining aggressive momentum. Additional card draw and mana fixing help ensure a consistent and proactive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful instant/sorcery spells. By utilizing a combination of low-cost creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Slickshot Show-Off along with spells like Burst Lightning and Flow State, you aim to deal consistent damage and control the board. Multiversal Passage allows you to fix your mana base and ensure you have the colors you need for your spells. The addition of Stormchaser's Talent and Vibrant Outburst provide additional ways to pressure your opponent and close out the game swiftly.

The main focus of this deck is to put early pressure on the opponent by playing efficient creatures like Mossborn Hydra, Sazh's Chocobo, and Badgermole Cub, supported by ramp cards like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage. The deck aims to maintain a steady stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Royal Treatment and Snakeskin Veil. The end goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures and close out the game quickly before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with a swarm of powerful creatures, making use of the aggressive nature of the mono green archetype. By utilizing cards like Ba Sing Se, Mossborn Hydra, and Mightform Harmonizer, you can build a strong board presence and deliver a quick, decisive blow to your opponent. Additionally, with cards like Earthbender Ascension and Lumbering Worldwagon, you have the ability to control the battlefield and ensure your creatures can attack freely. This deck aims to establish dominance early on and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a combination of fast and aggressive creatures, mana ramp, and powerful combat tricks. By quickly deploying creatures like Leatherhead, Swamp Stalker and Badgermole Cub, as well as mana accelerants like Llanowar Elves, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on. Cards like Brightglass Gearhulk and Practiced Offense provide additional power boosts to push through damage, while cards like Multiversal Passage and Seam Rip offer versatile answers to opposing threats. The deck seeks to maintain pressure and close out the game swiftly.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using creatures like Leatherhead, Pawpatch Recruit, and Brightglass Gearhulk. The deck also focuses on ramping up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Multiversal Passage to quickly play high-cost creatures like Surrak, Elusive Hunter. Additionally, there are cards like Skateboard and Seam Rip to provide removal and protection for your creatures. Overall, the goal is to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game to secure a win.

The deck focuses on using powerful creatures like Ardyn, the Usurper and Overlord of the Balemurk to quickly reanimate creatures from the graveyard, creating a strong board presence early in the game. Cards like Bringer of the Last Gift and Rapid Rescue help to bring creatures back from the graveyard, while Formidable Speaker and Superior Spider-Man provide additional support and control on the battlefield. The combination of reanimation and combo potential with cards like Forest and Jadzi, Steward of Fate make this deck a formidable threat to opponents in Standard 1 vs 1 gameplay.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on utilizing fast, aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It includes efficient creatures like Llanowar Elves and Badgermole Cub, supported by combat tricks like Practiced Offense and Seam Rip. The deck also includes a mix of powerful late-game threats like Brightglass Gearhulk and Surrak, Elusive Hunter to maintain pressure on the opponent. With a balance of early aggression and late-game power, this deck aims to establish board control and close out games swiftly before the opponent can mount a defense.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of creatures and spells that can deal damage efficiently. It utilizes aggressive creatures like Keen-Eyed Curator and Patchwork Beastie, alongside combat tricks like Burst Lightning and Violent Urge. The goal is to apply constant pressure and maintain board presence, while also having some control elements with cards like Royal Treatment and Break Out. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to all three colors necessary for the deck, allowing for smooth gameplay and efficient deployment of threats.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's actions and resources using a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. By disrupting the opponent's game plan and eliminating threats, the deck aims to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent in the long run. The inclusion of cards like Nowhere to Run and Duress helps to disrupt the opponent's hand, while cards like Requiting Hex and Vein Ripper provide removal options. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Winternight Stories and Emeritus of Ideation to ensure a steady stream of resources.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost, high-impact spells and creatures. The deck features a combination of direct burn spells like Burst Lightning and Shock, along with efficient creatures such as Greasewrench Goblin and Emberheart Challenger. By maintaining pressure on the opponent with a consistent stream of threats, the deck aims to end the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize or mount a defense.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with low-cost spells and creatures while disrupting their game plan with bounce spells and countermagic. It aims to maintain a steady stream of damage with evasive creatures like Slickshot Show-Off and powerful instant/sorcery spells like Burst Lightning. Multiversal Passage helps to fix mana and ensure a consistent flow of threats, while cards like Secret Identity and Eddymurk Crab provide utility and disruption. Overall, the deck seeks to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game through a mix of tempo plays and aggressive threats.
